messages:
maria.p: Quick sync — FinEdge wants clarity on retention + legal-hold for small-enterprise pilot. They asked for: 1) audit-search SLA 2) BYOK handshake time 3) legal-hold snapshot guarantees. Can we list concrete acceptance criteria for Q2 pilot?
sam.t: Adding context: pilot customers are on Dedicated + Private. They need guarantees for evidence export within 24h and legal-hold freeze across regions.
kevin.l: We should separate SLA vs contractual retention. SLA = searchability/ingest latency. Retention = policy.
dana: Agree. Propose MVP acceptance criteria:
- exportable evidence zip available within 24h
- legal-hold snapshot preserved immutable for 90d (customer-visible)
- BYOK handshake < 48h for onboarding (ops response time)
maria.p: Short wording for legal: "evidence export available within 24 hours; cryptographic chain-of-custody preserved and signed." Any legal concerns?
legal-ops: We need chain-of-custody proof: per-export manifest with merkle root + signer. Also require KMS attestation logs for handshake flow.
tae: Implementation note: per-export manifest + signature is straightforward. For KMS handshake timing, biggest risk is ops scheduling and HSM provisioning.
kevin.l: Operational fallout: snapshotting at scale -> storage + search latency impact. Suggest: full hot index for 30d, then cold archive 31-365d; provide on-demand rehydration for >90d with 24h materialization SLA.
sam.t: Customer specifically asked about sample-rate for audit queries. Proposal: default sampling disabled for legal-hold queries; for analytics we can sample. Keep legal queries full fidelity.
maria.p: Quick config example I'll include in the PR:
```
retention_policy:
  audit_logs:
    hot_days: 30
    cold_days: 335
  legal_hold:
    immutable_window_days: 90
  byok_handshake_deadline_hours: 48
```
maria.p: Draft acceptance criteria I'll send to FinEdge today. Quick poll: :thumbsup: if these three sound okay: export-24h, legal-hold-immutable-90d, byok-handshake-48h.
kevin.l: :thumbsup: from infra.
dana: :eyes: need product wording on 'immutable' vs 'attenuated access' (legal wants locked, ops wants emergency breakglass).
legal-ops: :thumbsup: + require manifest + KMS attestation; also require audit log retention proof for SOC2 mapping.
ops-bot: deploy: retention-index-worker v2 rolled to staging at 14:02 UTC.
tae: Also flag: SOC2 control mapping — need to map legal-hold snapshot to the 'Retention and Disposal' control. I'll add a note in the control matrix.
maria.p: Thanks. I'll update the PR: https://redwood.prod/retention/pull/299 with the acceptance list and link to runbook.
sam.t: One more ask from FinEdge: tenant-level API to request evidence export. Scope as 'pilot+alpha' (not GA).
maria.p: Noted. If no objections I'm going to lock this scope for the pilot. Call out blockers?
kevin.l: Blocker: KMS escalation for on-prem HSM scheduling. Need ETA from infra (could be 3-7 days).
dana: Blocker: UI for legal to mark a hold — small mock available by EOD.
maria.p: OK locking scope. I'll send to FinEdge and schedule a short sync with legal and infra tomorrow. Thanks all.
